status: predeclared; final evaluation not yet run
purpose: Test learned deploy-versus-stop exploration without changing sensing physics, observations, reward, or the mixed robustness curriculum.

policy_change.stochastic: Subtract log(number of legal deployment rows) from deployment logits before the shared softmax; STOP is unchanged. STOP competes with the mean exponential deployment score, not a catalogue-size-dependent sum.
policy_change.deterministic: Choose STOP when its probability is at least one half; otherwise choose the highest-probability legal sensor/site deployment.
policy_change.entropy: H(joint) - P(deploy)*log(number of legal deployments), equivalently H(gate) - P(deploy)*KL(conditional deployment || uniform).
policy_change.interpretation: Architecture and inference change as well as additional training; matched initialized controls distinguish the untrained architecture change from subsequent weight learning. No hardcoded coverage threshold.

candidate_training.initialization: Explicit transfer of frozen robust-v2 weights into the balanced actor; reset Adam and independent policy RNG. Not independent training from scratch.
candidate_training.checkpoint_selection: Maximum equally weighted mean return across normal, stress and capability validation profiles; strict greater, ties keep earlier checkpoint; no final-test access.

candidate_selection.criterion: Maximum equally weighted mean return across the three common validation profiles; ties retain the earlier run seed.

interpretation.success: Timely confirmed sensing of all simulated threats, not interception or field reliability.
interpretation.validation: All model selection and exploratory diagnostics remain development evidence; do not present selected validation gains as independent test results.
interpretation.lineage: Reserve all training, validation and selection exposure inherited from v1 and v2. Their published results motivated this experiment.
interpretation.do_not_censor: Keep impossible, unaffordable and poor-public-coverage cases; zero forecast coverage does not prove no true sensing.
interpretation.final_reservation: Carry forward the unopened v2 final-test suites; no new model is selected or tuned using them.
interpretation.changes: Disclose all exploratory/failed runs and record protocol changes before opening final tests.
